page: Vultr vcg-a100-12c-120g-80vram is a bare metal server belonging to the Dedicated Metal GPU family. It is equipped with 12 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs and 120.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 10.0 GB per vCPU. The storage subsystem consists of a 1400 GB local NVMe SSD, and the configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With 10.0 GB of RAM per dedicated core, this server provides a memory-optimized profile suitable for workloads requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute cores. The inclusion of 1400 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD storage ensures low-latency data access. While the server is positioned within the Dedicated Metal GPU family and lists NVIDIA as the GPU manufacturer, the active GPU count is specified as 0.0, meaning primary workloads rely on the dedicated Intel CPU resources.

This hardware configuration is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, caching layers, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and fast local NVMe storage. The high memory-to-core ratio makes it appropriate for running medium-sized databases, memory-resident data structures, and backend services.
